parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by avoiding coercion of objects with a `values` property, but it may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The patch introduces a conditional check for `pd.Series`, `pd.Index`, and `pd.DataFrame`, which may not cover all cases where `values` should be accessed. This could lead to unexpected behavior for other types with a `values` attribute.
The patch could be made more readable by adding a comment explaining why the conditional check is necessary.
